label: Monthly viewers who pay
basis: Freemium apps convert 2.1% of downloads within 35 days (subscription-app industry report, 2026); paid newsletters see about 1–3% of free readers pay. Monthly viewers are a less committed base than downloads, so the range sits below that.

label: Payers on the annual plan
basis: 34% of subscriptions are yearly (subscription-app industry report, 2026).

label: Monthly plan price
basis: Set by the owner on Oct 25, 2026 (F-3). Comparable products charge about $10 to $15 a month.

label: Annual plan price
basis: Set by the owner on Oct 26, 2026 (F-3): about ten months' price for twelve. Comparable annual plans run $90 to $100.

label: Monthly-plan cancellations per month
basis: Web subscriptions lose a median 3.6% a month (4–5% in digital media and education); consumer subscriptions about 6.5–7%; app-store monthly plans keep 17% after a year, about 14% a month.

label: Annual plans renewed after a year
basis: 44.1% of yearly plans renew (subscription-app industry report, 2025).

label: Connected traders per monthly viewer
basis: Assumption: no benchmark exists for this. Every connected trader costs a broker-data fee, and traders never pay.

label: Broker data per connected trader per month
basis: SnapTrade: $1 a month per connected user on the daily plan, $2 real-time; volume discounts on a custom plan. The current hourly sync gets only daily data on the $1 plan.

label: Broker data platform fee per month
Hosting and database fixed cost per month
basis: Hosting seat plus a database minimum (pricing pages, 2026).

label: Hosting and database per 1,000 monthly viewers
basis: Estimate: about 30 page views and 30 MB per viewer, plus requests and database share.

label: Billing fees as a share of revenue
basis: Card fee 2.9% + $0.30, billing 0.7%, tax 0.5%: about 7.1% on a $10 monthly charge and 4.4% on $90 a year; international cards and disputes add more.

label: Share of revenue paid to traders
basis: Set by the owner on Oct 26, 2026 (F-3): no creator payouts for now; they also need counsel first (POLICY F5).

label: Payout cost per paid trader per month
basis: Connected-account fee of $2 per active account a month, plus about $0.25 and 0.5% per payout.

label: Smallest monthly payout
basis: Assumption: pay out quarterly from $25, since a $5 payout would lose about 45% to fees.

label: Ad cost to win one paying viewer
basis: Finance apps pay about $11 per registration ($18 in fintech, mobile ad network report); divided by 3–8% of signups who pay.

label: New payers who came through ads
basis: A commission-free broker reported over 80% of new accounts came organically or by referral (IPO filing); share links are this product's main channel.
